pair_rule_scope.scope: selected same-run V3 draft and final_primary
pair_rule_scope.mask: pair union; exclude only two established zero denominators
pair_rule_scope.delta: after minus before; exact fractions; unavailable remains null
pair_rule_scope.correspondence: validated adopted sources before unique fallback and review
pair_rule_scope.quality: independent checks; deletion and replacement do not repair old facts

daily_density.explicit_count: matching reviewed exact count exempts defaults; mismatch deducts 100
daily_density.population: source-distinct primary visit occurrences on every requested date
daily_density.mean: equal requested-date weight; exact arithmetic; empty dates included
daily_density.overall: max(0, five-dimensional auxiliary score minus mean daily penalty)
daily_density.unknown: no guessed count or pace; bounds retained; unresolved deduction is unavailable

interpretation: Independent generations describe final differences. Unchanged same-run primary stages and zero Repair sends do not establish a Repair benefit. Nearby references are unscheduled and do not change primary visits.
